definitions.explanation: The reason or cause of something negative. Used to attribute blame or responsibility for an undesirable outcome.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寝不足|ねぶそく}→寝不足：07692_nebusoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: I have a headache because of lack of sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せいにしないで。
examples.english: Don't blame it all on yourself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧やすく⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Maybe because of my age, I've been getting tired easily lately.

notes:
せい is used to attribute the cause of something negative. The kanji form {所為|せい} exists but is rarely used; hiragana is standard.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Noun + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい: because of (noun)
- Verb (plain form) + せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: because (verb)
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to blame on
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: perhaps because of

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧: thanks to (positive cause); せい is for negative causes
- ～⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧: because of (neutral, can be positive or negative)

USAGE:
せい attributes blame or negative causation. For positive outcomes, use ⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧ instead.
